Your projects: list, create, rename and delete them.

Usage:
  voidhash project <command> [flags]

Aliases:
  project, projects

Commands:
  list       List the projects of an organization.
  create     Create a project in an organization.
  edit       Rename a project or change its logo.
  delete     Delete a project and everything in it.

Flags:
  -h, --help  Show help for this command

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Run 'voidhash project <command> --help' for more about a command.
